skills.name: 推锋
skills.text: 当你受到1点伤害后，你可以将一张牌置于你的武将牌上，称为“锋”。准备阶段，你移去所有“锋”，摸两倍数量的牌，你本回合使用【杀】的限制次数+X（X为你本回合移去“锋”的数量）。
skills.mapping: For each applied owner damage point, offer one optional owner hand/equipment card storage into the source skill instance's own face-up persistent 锋 pile. At actual owner Preparation, mandatorily remove every card from that exact source pile, freezing the removed identities and N once. Resolve the real discard and movement/equipment children before drawing 2N genuine cards; after draw children, add N to the owner's Slash-use quota for the actual turn. The store and cash-out steps use typed owning-frame receipts so replay and cold continuation cannot pay or grant the same step twice.
notes: One damage event of several points offers separately per point; there is no turn or phase storage limit.
The cash-out is compulsory when that exact pile is nonempty, while the damage-point storage choice is optional. The current skill name has no Locked tag.
The public pile is isolated by owner, skill ID and skill instance. It is not the legacy Authority zone and does not collect another character's cards.

historicalInterpretation.title: 《三国杀OL》9月22日2.80版本更新公告
historicalInterpretation.printedSkillText: 【推锋】1.当你受到1点伤害后，你可以将一张牌置于武将牌上，称为“锋”。2.准备阶段开始时，若你的武将牌上有“锋”，你将所有“锋”置入弃牌堆，摸2X张牌，然后你于此回合的出牌阶段内使用【杀】的次数上限+X（X为你此次置入弃牌堆的“锋”数）。
historicalInterpretation.interpretationOnly: This historical OL announcement explicitly expands removed 锋 to the discard pile and orders the draw before the quota increase. It defines X for this removal, whereas current hero/364 defines X using removal during this turn.

historicalInterpretation.title: 武将李通上架商城 特典送皮送秀超值奉献
historicalInterpretation.printedSkillText: 【推锋】当你受到1点伤害后，你可以将一张牌置于武将牌上，称为“锋”。准备阶段开始时，若你有“锋”，你移去所有“锋”，摸两倍数量的牌，然后本回合你可以多使用X张【杀】。（X为你本回合移去“锋”的数量）
historicalInterpretation.interpretationOnly: The introduction supports the current per-point storage and draw-then-Slash benefit sequence. Its prose mentions planning hand cards but does not formally restrict the printed generic card cost to hand only.

implementationInterpretations.currentTextBasis: The current text says one card without a hand-only qualifier.
implementationInterpretations.chosenBehavior: Select exactly one transferable owner hand or equipped card. Hidden cards under equipment and other persistent piles are not eligible.
implementationInterpretations.evidenceLimit: HE follows the engine's existing owned-card payment convention. No current formal official FAQ enumerating every zone was found.

implementationInterpretations.currentTextBasis: Current text says remove all 锋 and draw twice their count; the 2016 official OL announcement explicitly says move to the discard pile, draw 2X, then increase Slash quota.
implementationInterpretations.chosenBehavior: Use real discard movement, drain movement/equipment children, draw 2N and its children, then grant N extra uses until actual TurnEnded.
implementationInterpretations.evidenceLimit: The explicit discard destination is from historical official OL rules. Exact child timing, typed return and cold-resume behavior are engine implementation contracts rather than newly confirmed current FAQ.

implementationInterpretations.currentTextBasis: All 锋 are removed before the benefit is computed.
implementationInterpretations.chosenBehavior: Freeze the complete source pile and N once; intervening children cannot increase, reduce or repeat this removal's draw or quota grant.
implementationInterpretations.evidenceLimit: Receipt ownership and freezing are replay implementation contracts.

implementationInterpretations.boundary: multiple Preparation phases in one actual turn
implementationInterpretations.currentTextBasis: Current text defines X using removal in this turn; the 2016 announcement defines X for this removal.
implementationInterpretations.chosenBehavior: Each real removal grants N extra Slash uses from that removal, so successive removals naturally total the turn's removed count. Draw 2N for each real removal; do not add a cumulative total again.
implementationInterpretations.evidenceLimit: This reconciles the ordinary one-Preparation reading and avoids double-counting an inserted Preparation. No current formal official multiple-Preparation FAQ was found.

implementationInterpretations.currentTextBasis: Current abbreviated text says remove all 锋; the older official rules explicitly require existing 锋.
implementationInterpretations.chosenBehavior: An empty exact source pile creates no card movement, draw or quota benefit.
implementationInterpretations.evidenceLimit: No effect at zero is the shared operation's implementation boundary.

evidenceLimitations: No current formal official FAQ establishing a narrower hand-only storage source, inserted-Preparation accumulation policy, or exact engine suspension semantics was found.
